brief: Chad was born in Northumbria and became a pupil of Aidan at Lindisfarne. He became abbot of Lastingham in Yorkshire in 664. Chad is noted for his humility and his great zeal. He was briefly Bishop of York and then was appointed Bishop of Mercia in 669, with his see at Lichfield. He travelled tirelessly round his vast diocese. He died of the plague in 672.
